§6Solinium§f

§aSchrabidium's heavier isotope. More energy-dense, more dangerous, and a key to euphemium.§f

§bSolinium§f (Sa-327) is a neutron-capture product of schrabidium-326. It runs at §e17.5 RAD/s§f and blinds you like regular schrabidium. The critical difference: it is more energy dense, making it a stronger reactor fuel.

§6How To Get It§f:
§b•§f Irradiate schrabidium-326 in a nuclear reactor (neutron capture)
§b•§f Extract from schrabidium clusters that failed to convert into euphemium

§6What It Is For§f:
§b•§f §bPWR Fuel§f, stronger than HES-326, recycling solinium fuel has higher euphemium yield
§b•§f §bThe Blue Rinse§f, a bomb that deletes all living matter in its radius

§ePS:§f Solinium is a bottleneck for euphemium production. Dedicated schrabidium-breeding reactor cells plus reprocessing spent fuel will keep your supply flowing.
